ownerAgent: web_agent (website share landing pages and preview images)
lane: Website part of share cards v2 S1 (S1b of docs/proposals/SHARE_CARDS_V2_2026-11-28.vi.md). Owner approved on 28/11/2026: 'Đồng ý triển khai bước S1b.'
goal: Open the book_quote share link and QR on a real page (/vi/share/quote, /en/share/quote) that shows today's approved line from the same rotation as the app and lets the visitor read another book's line; give every share page its own 1200x630 Facebook preview image (OG) per locale; count QR arrivals (utm_medium=qr) separately from link taps.
successCriteria: shareVariants includes quote; /vi/share/quote and /en/share/quote build as static pages with their own title and description; the old /share address maps utm_campaign=book_quote to the quote panel.

The quote panel shows only approved book-quote items (review.status approved) with quote, reference, book title and question; the line for a date matches the app's homeBookQuote rotation (test with fixed dates).
readShareArrival accepts utm_medium qr next to card and invite; anything else is dropped.

scripts/build-share-og.mjs writes apps/web/public/share/og/<variant>-<locale>.png at 1200x630 with the brand fonts and logo, each under 200 KB; --check fails when one is missing, the wrong size, too big or extra; every variant page sets og:image to its file.
No birth data, name, typed question, note or journal reaches the page, the address or analytics; the quote page reads nothing from the address except the enumerated utm values.
untouchedSurfaces: App code and share-events are S1a (PR 91) and are not changed here.
No SQL, no Edge Function change, no Cloudflare or Vercel setting change; the web deploy uses the existing deploy:staging command after merge (Owner approved the S1b rollout on 28/11).

impact.entryPoint: Share link or QR from the Một câu cho hôm nay card opens /vi/share/quote; links pasted on Facebook show the per-page preview image.
impact.dataWrite: None. The page computes the line in the browser; analytics events carry only enumerated values (variant, surface, medium).
impact.backendContract: Unchanged. marketing-waitlist already forwards any utm_medium value it receives.
impact.adminVisibility: Unchanged; share_link_opened can now carry medium qr in the web analytics stream.
impact.privacySafety: Only approved library text is published; nothing from the visitor is sent; reflective copy reuses approved items.
impact.rollback: Roll back the Cloudflare Pages deployment or redeploy the previous dist; the app's quote link would then 404 again.
impact.observability: share_link_opened gains medium qr; share_landing_try for the quote variant when the visitor reads another book's line.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before edits; website deploy only after merge under the Owner's 28/11 approval; receipt recorded.

skillReview.evidence: OG images use the brand palette, the EB Garamond / Hanken Grotesk TTF masters in assets/brand/open-reflection/v1/source and the generated horizontal logo SVG; no infinity sign or letter N.

skillReview.name: nilaza-content-review
skillReview.evidence: No new reflective content: the page shows approved book-quote items unchanged. New page labels and preview copy are listed in the handoff for review.

dependencyReview.evidence: No new dependency: sharp (already used by build-share-card-thumbs and brand generation) renders the preview images from local TTF fonts with its text input.

securityReview.sensitiveData: No personal data on the page, in the address or in analytics; the line shown depends only on the visitor's local date.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret read or written; .env not opened.
securityReview.externalInput: The quote page reads only the enumerated utm values from the address (surface list, medium card|invite|qr); quote text comes from the build-time approved files and is rendered with textContent. Pages touched under apps/web/src/pages/[locale]/share/ ([variant].astro gains the quote variant and its og:image); bracket paths cannot be listed, so the scope is the pages directory.
securityReview.dependencies: No new package; sharp is already a root dependency used by existing generators.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No migration, no Edge Function. After merge the website is deployed with the existing deploy:staging command (Owner approved 28/11); receipt in docs/release/share-cards-v2-s1b-2026-11-28/.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if the quote page would need any non-approved text, if the web rotation cannot be shown to match the app's for fixed dates, or if a preview image cannot be kept under 200 KB at 1200x630.

managerTestPath: Mở https://nilaza.magicpendigital.com/vi/share/quote?utm_source=share&utm_medium=qr&utm_campaign=book_quote trên điện thoại → thấy câu hôm nay, nguồn sách và câu hỏi; bấm chọn sách khác → câu đổi. Dán link https://nilaza.magicpendigital.com/vi/share/quote vào một bài Facebook (chưa đăng) → ảnh xem trước riêng của trang Một câu hiện ra.
residualRisk: Facebook caches previews: pages shared before the deploy may keep the old image until re-scraped (Sharing Debugger, Owner). The web line of the day uses the visitor's local date, like the app, so people in different time zones may see different lines.
